name: innocent-stream
_comment: WRANGLER IS PINNED HERE BECAUSE THE DEPLOY IS NOT RUN FROM A LAPTOP.
Cloudflare's Workers Builds reads the Wrangler version out of this file
and uses it to deploy. Without the file it picks its own, and the two
features this Worker is built around have version floors: `[cache]`
needs 4.69.0 and the per-entrypoint `[exports.*.cache]` map needs
4.107.0. An older Wrangler does not warn — it either rejects the config
or drops the cache settings, and a Worker that deploys cleanly and
caches nothing is exactly the outcome this design exists to avoid.
